job.title: Information Security Analyst II - Federal Programs
job.pay_full: $116,000 – $145,000 a year (reasonably estimated yearly salary), plus equity and benefits; may include variable compensation

details.about: Datadog's Federal Programs team helps the company meet US Government security regulations and standards, including FedRAMP Rev. 5, FedRAMP 20x, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (CC SRG) and STIGs. This analyst brings information assurance and security expertise to the design, operation and maintenance of the Datadog product for those programs: assessing risks, validating and verifying security requirements, running the internal and external audit lifecycle, evaluating AI-backed products for federally regulated customers and building automations that help demonstrate compliance. Datadog operates as a hybrid workplace.
duties: Support security work toward US Government certifications and accreditations (FedRAMP, GovRAMP, Cloud Computing SRG)
Document Datadog's practices for customers, prospects and other stakeholders, and communicate with them directly
Work across security and engineering teams to design, implement and monitor security and compliance features
Support assessments, continuous monitoring and reporting
Explain Datadog's compliance posture to auditors, regulators and customers
Design and maintain defensive policies that let engineering teams move quickly
Turn complex customer documents (MSAs, security addendums) into concrete requirements for Engineering, Legal and Finance
Use modern tooling to make compliance programs more capable and efficient
needs: A BS and at least 5 years of relevant industry experience
A track record in security policy, compliance, information security operations or security consulting
A strong understanding of cloud services architecture (Amazon Web Services)
Experience designing, supporting, advising on and assessing security controls for a FedRAMP certified and/or DoD Impact Level 4/5 authorized system
Experience managing or implementing Federal continuous monitoring with external stakeholders
Experience implementing the Cloud Computing SRG and STIGs and working with eMASS
Accurate, thorough work that spots gaps in technical and compliance documentation
Have or be able to get a certification meeting applicable Government requirements
Ability to comply with ITAR and GovCloud requirements (e.g. a US Person located in the US)
nice: Eligibility to obtain a US Government security clearance in the future, or a current active adjudicated Public Trust Background Investigation
details.benefits: Reasonably estimated yearly salary $116,000 – $145,000, with a competitive equity package and possible variable compensation; actual pay depends on skills, qualifications and experience. Benefits include healthcare, dental, parental planning and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements and a discounted employee stock purchase plan, plus new-hire RSUs, professional development, a mentor and buddy program, and employee resource groups (Community Guilds).
notes: Candidates should be eligible for any US export control authorizations the role requires
Datadog encourages people who don't meet every qualification on day one to apply
